feeds.title: WABetaInfo
feeds.description: WABetaInfo is the main source where you can discover news and real-time updates about Whatsapp. WABetaInfo (also called WBI) was founded in January 15, 2016 on Twitter to independently announce news about WhatsApp, their updates and new features.

feeds.title: WATI Blog
feeds.description: Get to know more about Whatsapp, news, the latest updates and features and business uses of Whatsapp and more! WATI is a comprehensive customer communication platform for WhatsApp. An official WhatsApp API partner, WATI enables sales, customer support and marketing teams to use a single platform to send bulk messages, broadcasts, template messages, build chatbots with a no-code builder and manage customer queries with a single team inbox.

Read the latest in data science, systems, and infrastructure. Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities and grow businesses.

feeds.title: Meta Research
feeds.description: Explore learnings from the people who study human behavior for Meta. Meta UX researchers tackle some of the most complex challenges to gain deeper insights into how people interact with each other and the world around them.
